name: t0/greedy
why: Greedy thinking arm, to sit beside the t0.6/k20 one. Every off arm in this suite runs greedy, so a thinking arm at t0.6/k20 differs from its own off arm in sampling as well as reasoning -- the same confound that affects Qwen3.6-MoE and GLM on the Mac node. If greedy terminates here it gives the clean single-variable number; if it does not, that is itself the finding, and the runtime ceiling bounds the cost.
